newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Eli Lilly buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Eli Lilly buy reiterated.

text.p: --Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Tuesday it reiterated a buy recommendation on Eli Lilly and Co.
--It said the company's initial sales of Zyprexa, an antischizophrenic drug, could reach as high as $80 million in the 1996 Q4, up from a previously expected $55 million to $60 million.

--"With the large uptake in Zyprexa, we have raised our worldwide sales estimate for the product by $100 million in each of the years 1997-99, making our new forecasts $325 milllion, $520 million and $750 million," Rodman said in a report.

--Rodman said it continues to expect 1997 domestic sales of Eli Lilly's antidepressent drug, Prozac, to increase 11 percent to $1.9 billion and worldwide sales to rise at a similar rate to more than $2.6 billion.
